SELECT
    dpc.ProductCategoryName,
    sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, fs.DiscountAmount > 0)                                      AS promotional_revenue,
    sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, fs.DiscountAmount = 0)                                      AS full_price_revenue,
    sumIf(fs.DiscountAmount, fs.DiscountAmount > 0)                                   AS total_discount_given,
    sumIf(fs.SalesQuantity, fs.DiscountAmount > 0)                                    AS promo_units_sold,
    sumIf(fs.SalesQuantity, fs.DiscountAmount = 0)                                    AS full_price_units_sold,
    round(
        sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, fs.DiscountAmount > 0) /
        nullIf(sumIf(fs.SalesQuantity, fs.DiscountAmount > 0), 0), 2
    )                                                                                  AS avg_promo_price_per_unit,
    round(
        sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, fs.DiscountAmount = 0) /
        nullIf(sumIf(fs.SalesQuantity, fs.DiscountAmount = 0), 0), 2
    )                                                                                  AS avg_full_price_per_unit,
    round(
        promotional_revenue - full_price_revenue, 2
    )                                                                                  AS incremental_revenue_vs_full_price,
    round(
        100.0 * sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, fs.DiscountAmount > 0) /
        nullIf(sum(fs.SalesAmount), 0), 2
    )                                                                                  AS promo_revenue_pct
FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
JOIN retail.DimProduct AS dp
    ON fs.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS dps
    ON dp.ProductSubcategoryKey = dps.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS dpc
    ON dps.ProductCategoryKey = dpc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY dpc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY incremental_revenue_vs_full_price DESC
